heading.title: Special Provisions Relating to Certain Persons

article.title: Charge of tax in case of a firm.
article.content: In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in any Central Act for relevant tax year.
article.html:
324Charge of tax in case of a firm.

Section 324 · Chapter XVII · A.—Association of persons, firm, Hindu undivided family, etc. — 14.—Assessment of firms · page 388 of the Act

In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in any Central Act for relevant tax year.
